name: Exec Cluster E01: Zone Executor — SMA Crossover with Exits
description: Tests: long_and_short_zone, hold_until, position_size percent, stop_loss, take_profit
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Basic SMA Crossover Strategy
# Tests: E01 (long_and_short_zone), E02 (hold_until), E03 (position_size),
#        E07 (stop_loss), E08 (take_profit), E16 (wiring order)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL LOGIC ===
fast_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Crossover detection (faster MAs for reliable signal generation)
golden_cross = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)
death_cross = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# E02: hold_until persists pulse signal
held_long = hold_until(golden_cross, death_cross)
held_short = hold_until(death_cross, golden_cross)

# === EXECUTION (E16 wiring order) ===
# Step 1: Signal executor (E01)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Step 2: Position sizing (E03)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)

# Step 3: Exits (E07, E08)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)
